scope: Mock-DOM four-panel navigation, lazy Studio imports, same-origin Simulation startup and teardown, error/timeout recovery, keyboard focus, footer dialogs and accordions.

results.name: Overview is the default of four panels without loading the Studio
Selecting Videos shows only its panel and never requests GPU code
Active Studio deactivates on Videos and reuses its module when reopened
Studio tab opens ME120 first and resets to ME120 after another subject
Explicit Assembly and sensing shortcuts retain their intended views
A Studio import finishing after switching to Videos stays inactive
Keyboard navigation follows all four tabs with wrapping, Home and End
Simulation selection hides Studio and deactivates its renderer
The validation call to action opens Simulation without loading the Studio
An absent Simulation panel is ignored
A missing optional Videos panel is ignored without breaking navigation
Privacy and Terms buttons open their matching dialogs and restore originating focus
The research and application accordion groups keep independent active selections
Simulation stays unloaded until selected, then requests its local frame
Only a ready message from the active same-origin iframe dismisses loading
Leaving Simulation destroys the browsing context; reentry and Reload use fresh frames
Model errors and startup timeout both remove the frame and show a usable fallback
A hidden browser tab unloads controls and GPU; returning starts a fresh simulation
